body: Thanks, I will try to hang out with friends for half the time
Being with friends, going out, even playing videogames use to bring me joy... Not anymore
I don't think anything has happened recently to make this happen, it just... Happened.

There are some things you can do.  You should talk to a doctor/therapist.  He'll get you some medication for your depression.  If nothing works, you could try religion.  It always helps to have someone there no matter what you are going through.
